description: Transfer Files — Pair two devices, choose a file, and let the receiver accept it. Transfer Files sends one selected file at a time, up to 500 MiB.. Runs in the browser. Covered by signup welcome credits and by the Day Pass (24-hour unlimited on this workspace group). All three credit-based workspaces unlock with the same one-time credit pack — there is no per-workspace subscription. See mioffice.ai/pricing for current plans.
name: mio_p2p_file_transfer
